page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Main text in one column; marginal notes in the right margin beside the lines of the last paragraphs (Ioh. 5. references). Signature B 4 at the foot centre, catchword "mine" at the foot right.

main_text.p: dici posset Israelitas fuisse in opprobrio dum in Ægypto commorabantur, & variis afficiebantur probris, tunc vero devolutum fuisse ab iis hoc Ægypti Opprobrium cum Circumcisione peracta, mox erant introducendi in Terram illam quæ erat gloria & decus totius Terræ, ipsi decore & gloria in Terræ illius possessione veluti coronandi? approbata fuit hæc observatio, aliis tanquam ἐπίμετρον addenda.

Ad eorum confirmationem quæ à Collocutorum nonnullis, de probro Ægyptiaco ab Israelitis removendo, dicta sunt, quæ reperiuntur apud Spencerum in eam rem lectu non indigna, addere non gravabor. Sic ille de Legibus Ebræorum ritualib. f. 1. c. 4. de Circumcisione. „ Populus Israeliticus per annos quadraginta mansit „ incircumcisus in Deserto, & tum „ demum, procurante Josua, præ- Jof. 5. 4. 5. 6. „ putii jacturam passus est, cum in „ procinctu jam staret, ut in Terram „ promissam introduceretur. Quid autem in eo rerum suarum articulo circumciderentur Israelitæ, nisi quod „ in Gentem Sanctam, legibus ho- „ mine

page.notes: Marginal reference "Joc. 5. 4. 5. 6." is printed in the right margin; the page's text ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page. The printed word "Joc." is read as Ioh./Ios.; left as printed "Jof." [?]. Final line "„ mine" is partly at the foot of the page.
